title: Grilled Jamaican Pork Chops with Island Glaze and Coconut Custard
description: A Caribbean-inspired pork chop dish featuring a sweet and tangy island glaze served with a side of creamy coconut custard. Perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: Season pork chops with Jamaican jerk seasoning.
Grill pork chops for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix honey and coconut milk in a small saucepan.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in shredded coconut and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
To make coconut custard, combine coconut milk, egg, and vanilla extract in a blender.
Blend until smooth and pour into individual serving cups.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Serve grilled pork chops with island glaze and coconut custard on the side.
